speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about two months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but I do notice I get short of breath when I try to do physical work. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (likely due to left ventricular dysfunction causing pulmonary congestion).
